scripts.test: npm run test:portable && npm run test:sandbox
scripts.test:portable: tsx --test tests/path-guard.test.ts tests/network.test.ts tests/build-network.test.ts tests/mcp.integration.test.ts tests/host-git.test.ts tests/providers.test.ts tests/mcp-auth.test.ts tests/control-mcp.test.ts tests/agent-tools.test.ts tests/hardening.test.ts tests/remote-cleanup.test.ts tests/router.test.ts tests/remote.test.ts tests/remote-followup.test.ts tests/remote-direct.test.ts tests/recent-task-index.test.ts tests/fast-path.test.ts tests/host-tool-discovery.test.ts tests/usability.test.ts tests/workspace-session.test.ts tests/local-runtime.test.ts tests/local-runtime-install.test.ts tests/windows-job-guard.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run check:icon && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run control:check
scripts.check:portable: npm run check:icon && npm run typecheck && npm run test:portable && npm run control:check
scripts.control:check: tsc -p tsconfig.control-plane.json && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config control-plane/wrangler.jsonc --outdir dist/control-plane
